entities.summary: John Michael Miller, CSB is a Canadian retired bishop of the Catholic Church. He is the Archbishop Emeritus of Vancouver, having served as its ordinary from 2009 until 2025. He previously served as the coadjutor archbishop of Vancouver and as Secretary of the Congregation for Catholic Education. Prior to his appointment as bishop, he was a professor and academic administrator at the University of St. Thomas (UST) in Houston.
